method: All v1-v6 independent current projects and v4/v5 named snapshots saved in six real IndexedDBs. Exact exported Blob originals are retrieved via v6 downloads before/after a new connection and continued outdoor/prop editing. This geometry-only chain has no bitmap resources; bitmap decoding is covered by the separate mixed offline test.
